sign_convention: trajectory ordered by time_window_min DESCENDING (farthest-from-onset first); positive tau / Sen's slope == AUROC rises toward onset == clinical faithfulness
bootstrap_resample_unit: highest identifiable unit: patient (subject_id) for EPIC/VitalDB, surgical case (case_id) for MOVER/SIS
sample: episodes with an observed bin at every centre from 60 to 5
shares: each side divided by the widening; they sum to 1 by construction
